meta.name: add-dial
meta.description: Add Dial channel integration — a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给应用接入真实号码,支持短信与AI语音通话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发需要电话或短信能力的应用
copy.tagline_en: Add a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs phone or SMS capabilities

howto.what: Claude 会通过 Dial 获得一个真实电话号码，能收发短信、接打 AI 语音电话。它原生接入，不需要额外的聊天 SDK。
howto.when: 当你要给 Claude 添加 Dial 电话号码或开通短信/语音功能时，Claude 会执行这套安装配置。

say.text: 给 Claude 添加一个 Dial 电话号码，包括短信和语音。
say.note: 会按技能步骤开始安装并配置 Dial 线路。

say.text: 把 Dial 接进来，并帮我把手机和线路配对。
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册线路，然后请你配对手机。

say.text: 用仅我可用的模式配置 Dial 电话号码。
say.note: 会要求你选择 owner 权限，并只允许配对手机访问。

howto.what_en: Claude gets a real phone number on Dial and can send/receive SMS and make/receive AI voice calls. The channel is wired natively, no Chat SDK bridge.
howto.when_en: When you ask to add a Dial number for Claude, or to enable SMS/voice messaging through Dial, Claude runs this setup.

say_en.text: Add a Dial phone number for Claude, with SMS and voice.
say_en.note: Claude will run the install and configure the line.

say_en.text: Set up the Dial channel and pair my phone to it.
say_en.note: Then it registers the line and asks you to pair.

say_en.text: Configure the Dial line so only I can use it.
say_en.note: Sets owner mode; only your paired phone can reach it.
